company.name: Doxel
company.shortDescription: Doxel delivers facilities faster by using AI to automate progress reporting for construction
company.description:
Doxel is an AI software solution that automates progress & schedule tracking for all trades using cameras

Using a 360 camera, our AI reports percent complete against schedule and tracks production rates, so you know where the project is and where it’s headed

It was introduced in 2016 and operates in Redwood City, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Doxel is researching systems and methods for evaluating construction of structures by integrating building information modeling data and scheduling data, as described in 'Generating status of construction site based on hierarchical modeling.' Additionally, they are developing methods for tracking progression of a construction site over time using imaging and computer models, as outlined in 'Tracking an ongoing construction by using fiducial markers.' These efforts focus on automating construction progress reporting and site evaluation.
